title: Projection-formula normalization for a proper retraction and its closed section
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$. Schemes are separated finite-type $k$-schemes and morphisms are $k$-morphisms [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Write $R_Z=\mathcal O_{E,Z}$ for the pulled-back condensed coefficient ring, $D(Z)=D(\Mod_{R_Z})$ for its unbounded derived category [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], and $\mathcal L(Z)=\Loc(\Dbc(Z,\mathcal O_E))$ [sk-def-sfb-constructible, sk-def-localizing-closure]. Pullbacks and direct images are the canonical derived functors with adjunction $h^*\dashv Rh_*$ [def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull-adjunction], and pullback coefficients are identified by [sk-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients]. All tensors are derived tensors over $R_Z$ [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. For a proper $h:Z\to B$, let $\pi_{h,L,N}:L\otimes Rh_*N\to Rh_*(h^*L\otimes N)$ be the canonical projection map, the adjoint transpose of $h^*(L\otimes Rh_*N)\simeq h^*L\otimes h^*Rh_*N\xrightarrow{1\otimes c_{h,N}}h^*L\otimes N$, where the first map is the pullback/tensor comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback] and $c_h$ is the canonical counit.

Let $r:V\to X$ be proper and $i:X\hookrightarrow V$ a closed immersion with $ri=1_X$ [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-closed-immersion]. For $M\in\mathcal L(X)$ put
$$a_M:r^*M\otimes Ri_*R_X\xrightarrow{\pi_{i,r^*M,R_X}}Ri_*(i^*r^*M\otimes R_X)\simeq Ri_*M.$$
Identify $Rr_*Ri_*$ with the identity by the canonical direct-image composition isomorphism, and $i^*r^*$ with the identity by the corresponding pullback composition isomorphism [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback]. Then
$$Rr_*(a_M)\circ\pi_{r,M,Ri_*R_X}=1_M.$$
In particular, whenever the displayed projection maps are inverted, $\pi_{r,M,Ri_*R_X}^{-1}\circ Rr_*(a_M^{-1})=1_M$ under these identifications.
